Nvidia almighty: Chip riches flood through AI universe
market.summary: Data: S&P Capital IQ Pro; Chart: Erin Davis/Axios Visuals Nvidia made billions selling AI's essential ingredient: chips. Now it's plowing those riches straight back into the AI ecosystem, betting on a buildout that craves ever more compute. Why it matters: Nvidia has become the AI industry's supplier, banker and kingmaker, feeding a self-reinforcing cycle in which chip profits finance the next wave of chip demand. State of play: Already the world's most valuable company, Nvidia is now worth more than five of the 11 sectors that make up the S&P 500. The chipmaker reported nearly $60 billion in quarterly profit Wednesday, prompting The Kobeissi Letter to call the results "the most impressive earnings in history." Nvidia believes its reign is far from over, telling investors to expect roughly 70% revenue growth even from today's extraordinary heights. Zoom out: Nvidia's vast chip windfall has enabled the company to take on a new role as financial patron of the entire AI industry. Nvidia is involved in more than $750 billion worth of AI investments, financing deals and partnerships, according to PitchBook — a staggering footprint for a company whose core business is still selling chips. That figure does not include this week's reported $13 billion acquisition of Hugging Face , which would give Nvidia control over one of the industry's most important model-distribution hubs. CEO Jensen Huang has enlisted Wall Street to mobilize more than $500 billion for AI infrastructure, channeling outside capital toward the data-center buildout that drives more than 90% of Nvidia's quarterly revenue . Between the lines: The strategy creates a powerful flywheel: The more money Nvidia helps pour into AI, the more compute the industry builds — and the more chips it needs. What they're saying: Huang argues Nvidia's expanding reach reflects a position no other company can match, calling its role in the AI market "singular." "We're the only company in the world that ... offers an entire AI factory platform," Huang said on Wednesday's earnings call. "Most companies just don't have the skills to do that." Reality check: Critics say Nvidia's flywheel looks uncomfortably circular. The company is helping finance customers and infrastructure projects that then spend heavily on its own hardware, raising questions about how much demand is being supported by Nvidia's own balance sheet. Huang has dismissed those concerns, telling CNBC Wednesday that Nvidia's investments will generate "tremendous returns" and that "the risk is low." Threat level: The cozy relationship between Nvidia and its biggest customers is becoming increasingly competitive. OpenAI, Google, Amazon, Microsoft and others are developing their own custom chips designed to reduce their dependence on Nvidia. OpenAI claims its new Jalapeno chip outperforms Nvidia hardware on some workloads. Nvidia, meanwhile, is spending billions developing its own open-source AI models, aiming to become the American champion in a field increasingly dominated by Chinese models. The bottom line: The result is an unusually tangled ecosystem in which Nvidia is simultaneously supplier, investor, partner — and increasingly competitor — to AI's biggest players.

Key growth drivers include renovation cycles, automotive refinishing, and infrastructure maintenance, while investment priorities focus on low-residue adhesives, recyclable backings, and automated inspection systems.

headlines.title: Sherwin-Williams (SHW) Up 1.4% Since Last Earnings Report: Can It Continue?
headlines.summary: Sherwin-Williams reported Q2 2026 earnings that beat estimates with adjusted EPS of $3.70 (up 9.5% YoY) and revenues of $6.79 billion (up 7.5% YoY). All three segments showed growth, supported by the Suvinil acquisition. The company raised full-year 2026 guidance for both net sales and earnings. However, management expects demand softness to continue in the second half. The stock has gained 1.4% since the earnings report but underperformed the S&P 500, and carries a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) rating.

CHA.title: Chagee Announces Second Quarter 2026 Unaudited Financial Results
CHA.summary: Chagee Holdings Limited (NASDAQ: CHA) reported Q2 2026 results with net revenues increasing 2.5% to RMB3,414.6 million and GAAP net income rising significantly to RMB464.8 million from RMB77.2 million year-over-year. However, the company faced headwinds with Greater China GMV declining and same-store GMV growth remaining negative at -16.1%. The company expanded its teahouse network to 7,639 locations and authorized a US$150 million share repurchase program.

IBIO.title: iBio Reports Fiscal Year 2026 Financial Results and Provides Corporate Update
IBIO.summary: iBio, a clinical-stage biotechnology company, announced fiscal year 2026 results marking its transition to clinical development with initiation of Phase 1 trials for IBIO-600, a long-acting anti-myostatin antibody. The company advanced IBIO-610 into IND-enabling studies showing fat-selective weight loss potential and completed successful financings totaling $126 million, extending cash runway into fiscal 2028. R&D expenses increased to $19.6 million from $8.3 million year-over-year, while the company held $88 million in cash and investments.

XRTX.title: XORTX Announces Termination and Postponement of Investor Relations Program
XRTX.summary: XORTX Therapeutics has terminated its US$2.5 million investor relations and marketing agreement with IR Agency LLC effective August 7, 2026, with all funds returned to the company. The decision was made to postpone the IR program during the company's voluntary delisting from the TSX Venture Exchange, expected to take effect September 1, 2026. The company aims to reduce regulatory complexity and focus resources on clinical development. Additionally, XORTX disclosed previously omitted finder's fees of US$240,000 related to its April 2026 acquisition of Vectus Biosystems' Renal Anti-Fibrotic Therapeutic Program.

SMPL.title: SMPL DEADLINE ALERT: RGRD Law Files Class Action Lawsuit Against The Simply Good Foods Company and Announces Opportunity for Investors with Substantial Losses to Lead Investor Class Action Lawsuit Before October 13, 2026 Deadline
SMPL.summary: Robbins Geller has filed a class action lawsuit against The Simply Good Foods Company, alleging that executives made materially false and misleading statements regarding the OWYN acquisition. The company failed to disclose product quality issues with pea protein formulations, loss of key personnel, and operational integration problems. Stock prices fell 17% in October 2025 and 27% in April 2026 following earnings revelations of OWYN sales declines and a $187 million impairment charge. Investors with substantial losses can seek lead plaintiff status before October 13, 2026.

Cruz is investigating Alphabet Inc. for potential securities law violations following reports that Google's Gemini 3.5 Pro AI model is months behind schedule and disappointing in performance. The investigation was triggered by two significant events: a 4.4% stock price drop on July 16, 2026 after Bloomberg reported delays, and a further 7% intraday decline on July 23, 2026 following Alphabet's announcement of expanded capital expenditures to $195-205 billion and negative free cash flow of $5.9 billion for Q2 2026.

GOOG.title: Ken Burns and PBS LearningMedia Bring Interactive Educational Content for Classrooms to YouTube
GOOG.summary: Ken Burns and PBS LearningMedia announced the launch of 'Ken Burns in the Classroom' on YouTube, bringing free, curriculum-aligned educational content to teachers and students. The initiative begins with three courses focused on The American Revolution, featuring professionally edited film segments and interactive materials. Additional courses from Burns's extensive filmography will follow in coming weeks.

GOOG.title: GOOGL Rides on Strong Advertising Revenues: Can It Beat RDDT and META?
GOOG.summary: Alphabet reported Q2 2026 Google ad revenues of $81.63B, up 14.4% YoY, driven by Search growth (17% to $63.27B) and YouTube ads (13% to $11.06B). Gemini AI integration is boosting advertiser performance with 500,000 adopters seeing 15% more conversions. However, Alphabet faces tougher Q3 comparisons and FX headwinds, while competitors Reddit and Meta continue gaining ground with strong ad revenue growth.

GOOG.title: NFLX vs. GOOGL: Which Streaming & Ad Stock Has an Edge Right Now?
GOOG.summary: In a detailed comparison of two digital media giants, Alphabet (GOOGL) emerges as the stronger investment choice over Netflix (NFLX). Alphabet demonstrates broad-based growth across Search, YouTube, and Cloud with a $514 billion backlog and innovative AI-driven ad formats, while Netflix faces decelerating revenue growth and competitive pressure from short-form video platforms. Trading at a lower forward P/E multiple (20.44x vs 21.73x) with stronger year-to-date performance (+8.5% vs -14.8%), Alphabet offers better near-term upside potential.

GOOG.title: Camus Energy Selected for Google for Startups Accelerator Program Focused on AI Solutions for the Energy Industry

The company will demonstrate its FlexConnect software to major utilities including Duke Energy, Edison International, and PG&E, enabling AI data centers to connect to the grid 3-5 years faster using flexible operating limits and existing infrastructure.

GOOG.title: FlowX.AI Brings Mission-Critical Industry AI Agents to Gemini Enterprise
GOOG.summary: FlowX.AI announced the availability of specialized industry agents through Google Cloud Marketplace and Gemini Enterprise, focusing on mission-critical workflows in financial services, insurance, logistics, and other complex industries. The company's agents are designed to handle high-stakes processes requiring accuracy and evidence-based decision-making, with initial offerings including loan pack completeness verification and document extraction for capital markets.

BAC.title: Can JPMorgan's Stablecoin Push Strengthen Its Digital Payments Edge?

However, the stock has declined 7% year-to-date compared to the S&P 500's 12.1% gain. The company received a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) rating, suggesting near-term performance in line with the market.

CRDO.title: Marvell Technology (MRVL) Q2 Earnings and Revenues Beat Estimates
CRDO.summary: Marvell Technology reported Q3 2026 earnings of $0.94 per share, beating consensus estimates of $0.93, with revenues of $2.74 billion exceeding expectations by 1.03%. The stock has gained 188.4% year-to-date and holds a Zacks Rank #2 (Buy) rating. Meanwhile, Credo Technology Group is expected to report quarterly earnings of $1.16 per share (up 123.1% YoY) with revenues of $470.73 million when it reports on September 1.

MRVL.title: Marvell Technology (MRVL) Q2 Earnings and Revenues Beat Estimates
MRVL.summary: Marvell Technology reported Q3 2026 earnings of $0.94 per share, beating consensus estimates of $0.93, with revenues of $2.74 billion exceeding expectations by 1.03%. The stock has gained 188.4% year-to-date and holds a Zacks Rank #2 (Buy) rating. Meanwhile, Credo Technology Group is expected to report quarterly earnings of $1.16 per share (up 123.1% YoY) with revenues of $470.73 million when it reports on September 1.

GWRE.title: Autodesk (ADSK) Q2 Earnings and Revenues Top Estimates
GWRE.summary: Autodesk reported Q3 2026 earnings of $3.30 per share, beating consensus estimates of $3.12, with revenues of $2.05 billion exceeding expectations by 1.84%. However, the stock has declined 13.9% year-to-date versus the S&P 500's 12.1% gain. The company holds a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) rating with mixed estimate revisions, suggesting near-term performance in line with the market. Peer Guidewire Software is expected to report results on September 3.

PATH.title: Workday (WDAY) Surpasses Q2 Earnings and Revenue Estimates
PATH.summary: Workday reported Q3 2026 earnings of $2.75 per share, beating consensus estimates of $2.62, with revenues of $2.65 billion exceeding expectations by 0.57%. However, the stock has declined 11.2% year-to-date versus the S&P 500's 12.1% gain. The company received a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) rating with mixed estimate revisions. UiPath is expected to report results on September 3 with flat earnings expectations of $0.15 per share but 9.9% revenue growth.

TM.title: NAFA Announces Winners of 2026 Green Fleet Awards
TM.summary: NAFA Fleet Management Association announced the winners of its 2026 Green Fleet Awards, with the City of Long Beach, California receiving the top honor. The awards recognize fleets across North America leading in sustainability and environmental stewardship. Winners were selected across multiple categories including alternative fuel integration, technology leadership, and green garage practices, with winners representing both government and commercial fleets.

MUX.title: McEwen Copper Completes US$240 Million Term Loan to Advance Los Azules Toward Final Investment Decision
MUX.summary: McEwen Copper, a 46.3%-owned subsidiary of McEwen Inc., has closed a $240 million senior secured 4-year term loan to advance the Los Azules copper project in Argentina. The financing includes contributions from Sprott Natural Resource Investment Partners ($112M) and Chairman Rob McEwen ($85M). A final investment decision is expected in mid-2027 with commercial production targeted for 2030. The project has completed over 5,600 meters of drilling and engineering is ahead of schedule.

BABA.title: BABA INVESTOR ALERT: Alibaba Group Holding Limited Investors with Substantial Losses Have Opportunity to Lead Shareholder Class Action Lawsuit Before October 5, 2026 Deadline – RGRD Law
BABA.summary: Robbins Geller announces a class action lawsuit against Alibaba Group Holding Limited for alleged securities violations. The lawsuit claims Alibaba made false statements about its control by China's Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and engaged in unauthorized AI model distillation attacks. The stock declined following disclosure of Alibaba's inclusion on the U.S. Department of Defense's Chinese military companies list and Anthropic's accusations of illicit AI model access. Investors with substantial losses can seek appointment as lead plaintiff before October 5, 2026.

BABA.title: Bronstein, Gewirtz & Grossman LLC Urges Alibaba Group Holding Limited Investors to Act: Class Action Filed Alleging Investor Harm
BABA.summary: A class action lawsuit has been filed against Alibaba Group Holding Limited alleging securities fraud violations. The lawsuit claims that Alibaba made materially false and misleading statements regarding its business operations and prospects, specifically related to alleged control by the Chinese Ministry of Industry and Information Technology (MIIT) and ongoing distillation attacks against third-party AI models. The class period covers purchases between June 26, 2025 and June 24, 2026, with a lead plaintiff deadline of October 5, 2026.

BABA.title: Alibaba Group Holding Limited (BABA) Investors: Securities Fraud Class Action Filed, Contact Hagens Berman Before October 5, 2026 Lead Plaintiff Deadline
BABA.summary: A securities fraud class action has been filed against Alibaba Group Holding Limited, alleging the company misrepresented its ties to China's Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and concealed unauthorized access to third-party AI models. The lawsuit covers the period from June 26, 2025 to June 24, 2026, with a lead plaintiff deadline of October 5, 2026. Alibaba's stock fell approximately 4-5% following regulatory disclosures in June 2026.

BABA.title: BABA Investors Have Opportunity to Lead Alibaba Group Holding Limited Securities Fraud Lawsuit with SBS Law
BABA.summary: Schall, Brown & Schwartz LLP announces a securities fraud class action lawsuit against Alibaba Group Holding Limited for allegedly making false and misleading statements regarding its control by the Chinese Ministry of Industry and Information and undisclosed AI model distillation activities. The class period spans June 26, 2025 to June 24, 2026, with a deadline of October 5, 2026 for investors to participate.

HOFT.title: Hooker Furnishings to Host Second Quarter Earnings Call September 11th
HOFT.summary: Hooker Furnishings Corporation will present its fiscal 2027 second quarter financial results via teleconference and live webcast on September 11, 2026 at 9:00 AM Eastern Time. The quarter covered the period from May 4, 2026 to August 2, 2026. The company, in its 102nd year of business, designs and markets furniture across residential, hospitality, and contract markets through multiple brands including Bradington-Young, HF Custom, and Sunset West.

WMT.title: Kohl's Q2 Earnings Beat Shifts Focus to Holiday Execution and Margins
WMT.summary: Kohl's reported adjusted Q2 EPS of $1.28, up 128.6% year-over-year, beating expectations despite a 0.9% revenue decline. The company raised full-year adjusted EPS guidance to $1.80-$2.40 and improved its sales outlook. However, margin expansion was significantly aided by $100M in tariff refunds, and the company faces execution challenges in the critical holiday season ahead.

WMT.title: What Sources Does ChatGPT Cite for Products? Azoma Publishes the Data and Explains How Brands Get Recommended
WMT.summary: Azoma released analysis of millions of ChatGPT shopping citations, revealing that ChatGPT sources recommendations from 41% earned media, 37% retailer listings, 19% user-generated content, and 3% brand websites. The company emphasizes that brands cannot buy placement in ChatGPT recommendations and must instead optimize presence across all cited sources. Azoma's platform helps enterprise brands track visibility and close gaps across multiple AI shopping agents.

WMT.title: The AI Honeymoon is Over: Momentum AI Austin 2026 Unveils Full C-Suite Agenda and Premier Sponsors to Drive Enterprise ROI
WMT.summary: Reuters Events announced Momentum AI Austin 2026, an enterprise AI summit scheduled for September 24-25, 2026, bringing together over 500 senior leaders including CIOs, CTOs, and Chief AI Officers. The summit addresses the critical challenge of transitioning AI from pilot projects to scalable business execution, featuring keynotes on rising compute costs and adoption bottlenecks, with speakers including FTC Chairman Andrew Ferguson and executives from major corporations like Walmart, UnitedHealth Group, and Charles Schwab.

QCOM.title: The Cellular IoT and LPWA Chipset and Module Market (10th Edition) | Industry Forecast to Reach 1.32 Billion Annual Module Shipments by 2030
QCOM.summary: Global demand for IoT wide area networking technology is entering sustained growth, with annual shipments of cellular and non-3GPP LPWA IoT modules forecast to increase from 909 million units in 2025 to 1.32 billion units in 2030, representing a 7.7% CAGR. The market is driven by expanding connected device deployments and adoption of 5G eMBB, RedCap, eRedCap, NB-IoT, LTE-M, LoRa, and Sigfox technologies across multiple vertical markets and regions.

UTHR.title: Music Beats Cancer Launches “Thumbs Up for a Cure” to Support the Next Generation of Childhood Cancer Treatments
UTHR.summary: Music Beats Cancer, a nonprofit supporting cancer-fighting biotechnologies, will host its inaugural 'Thumbs Up for a Cure' event on September 5 at LongHouse Reserve in East Hampton. The event brings together families, biotech innovators, philanthropists, and artists to advance childhood cancer treatments. A unique Kids Q&A will feature children evaluating promising technologies from biotech companies developing treatments for difficult-to-treat pediatric cancers including DIPG.

DVLT.title: Datavault AI Inc. Investors Have Until October 5th to Contact Bragar Eagel & Squire, P.C. Seeking Lead Plaintiff Role
DVLT.summary: A class action lawsuit has been filed against Datavault AI Inc. (NASDAQ: DVLT) for allegedly making materially false and misleading statements regarding corporate partnerships, trading volume on its platform, and undisclosed connections to a convicted felon. Investors who purchased securities between September 4, 2024 and October 30, 2025 have until October 5, 2026 to apply as lead plaintiff.

DVLT.title: BlackRock Investor News: If You Have Suffered Losses in BlackRock, Inc. Mutual Funds, You Are Encouraged to Contact The Rosen Law Firm About Your Rights
DVLT.summary: Rosen Law Firm is investigating potential securities claims against BlackRock, Inc. for allegedly issuing materially misleading business information to investors in its mutual funds. The firm is also pursuing class action lawsuits against Intuit Inc. and Datavault AI Inc., encouraging investors with significant losses to secure legal counsel before upcoming deadlines.

DVLT.title: ROSEN, GLOBAL INVESTOR COUNSEL, Encourages Datavault AI Inc. Investors to Secure Counsel Before Important Deadline in Securities Class Action - DVLT
DVLT.summary: A securities class action lawsuit has been filed against Datavault AI Inc. (DVLT) for allegedly making materially false and misleading statements regarding corporate partnerships, trading volume on its platform, and undisclosed connections to a convicted felon. Investors who purchased securities between September 4, 2024 and October 30, 2025 may be eligible for compensation, with an October 5, 2026 deadline to serve as lead plaintiff.

DVLT.title: DVLT Investors Have Opportunity to Lead Datavault AI Inc. Securities Fraud Lawsuit with SBS Law
DVLT.summary: A class action lawsuit has been filed against Datavault AI Inc. (NASDAQ: DVLT) for securities violations. The company allegedly made false and misleading statements about the value of its AI partnerships, overstated trading activity on its platform, and suffered reputational harm when ties to a convicted felon were revealed. The class period spans September 4, 2024 to October 30, 2025, with a deadline of October 5, 2026 for investors to participate.

SPRY.title: ARS PHARMACEUTICALS ALERT: Bragar Eagel & Squire, P.C. Announces that a Class Action Lawsuit Has Been Filed Against ARS Pharmaceuticals and Encourages Investors to Contact the Firm
SPRY.summary: A class action lawsuit has been filed against ARS Pharmaceuticals (NYSE:SPRY) for allegedly providing misleading statements about expanded insurance coverage for its epinephrine nasal spray product 'neffy' with CVS Caremark. The company reportedly expressed confidence that coverage would begin July 1, 2026, while failing to disclose risks of delays that would impact summer and back-to-school seasons. Investors who purchased ARS securities between March 9 and June 24, 2026 can apply to be lead plaintiff by October 5, 2026.

SPRY.title: ROSEN, NATIONAL TRIAL COUNSEL, Encourages ARS Pharmaceuticals, Inc. Investors to Secure Counsel Before Important Deadline in Securities Class Action – SPRY
SPRY.summary: Rosen Law Firm is reminding investors who purchased ARS Pharmaceuticals securities between March 9, 2026 and June 24, 2026 of an October 5, 2026 deadline to join a securities class action lawsuit. The lawsuit alleges that ARS Pharmaceuticals provided false and misleading statements regarding the timeline for expanded insurance coverage of its epinephrine nasal spray product (neffy) through CVS Caremark, causing investors to purchase securities at artificially inflated prices.

SPRY.title: EQPT DEADLINE NOTICE: ROSEN, A HIGHLY RECOGNIZED LAW FIRM, Encourages EquipmentShare.com Inc Investors with Losses in Excess of $100K to Secure Counsel Before Important Deadline in Securities Class Action - EQPT
SPRY.summary: Rosen Law Firm is notifying investors in EquipmentShare.com Inc, ARS Pharmaceuticals Inc, and Barclays PLC of ongoing securities class action lawsuits. EquipmentShare investors who purchased shares during the IPO or within the Class Period are encouraged to join the lawsuit, with a lead plaintiff deadline of September 21, 2026. The lawsuits allege material misstatements and omissions regarding business operations and financial disclosures.

BZAI.title: Bragar Eagel & Squire, P.C. Reminds Blaize Holdings, Inc. Investors to Contact the Firm Regarding Their Rights Before October 5th
BZAI.summary: A class action lawsuit has been filed against Blaize Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: BZAI) in the U.S. District Court for the Central District of California. The lawsuit alleges that Blaize made false and misleading statements regarding announced transactions with unequipped entities, improper revenue recognition, and materially false public statements. Investors who purchased Blaize securities between July 18, 2025 and April 28, 2026 have until October 5, 2026 to apply to be appointed as lead plaintiff.

BZAI.title: ROSEN, NATIONAL INVESTOR COUNSEL, Encourages Blaize Holdings, Inc. Investors to Secure Counsel Before Important Deadline in Securities Class Action First Filed by the Firm - BZAI
BZAI.summary: Rosen Law Firm is urging investors who purchased Blaize Holdings securities between July 18, 2025 and April 28, 2026 to join a securities class action lawsuit. The lawsuit alleges that Blaize made false statements about business transactions, improperly recognized revenue, and misled investors about its growth. The lead plaintiff deadline is October 5, 2026.

BZAI.title: INVESTOR ALERT: Pomerantz Law Firm Reminds Investors with Losses on their Investment in Blaize Holdings, Inc. of Class Action Lawsuit and Upcoming Deadlines – BZAI
BZAI.summary: Pomerantz Law Firm has filed class action lawsuits against Blaize Holdings, Inc. and is investigating claims against Rackspace Technology and The Chemours Company. The Blaize lawsuit stems from allegations of securities fraud related to a purported deal with NeoTensr, a 4-month-old company with allegedly photoshopped product images. Following a short report by Pelican Way Research on April 28, 2026, Blaize's stock fell 12.04%. Investors have until October 5, 2026, to join the class action.

BZAI.title: BZAI Investors Have Opportunity to Lead Blaize Holdings, Inc. Securities Fraud Lawsuit with SBS Law
BZAI.summary: Schall, Brown & Schwartz LLP has filed a class action lawsuit against Blaize Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: BZAI) for alleged violations of securities laws. The complaint alleges that Blaize made false and misleading statements by announcing transactions with entities incapable of meaningful business activities and improperly recognizing revenue. The class period spans from July 18, 2025 to April 28, 2026, with a deadline of October 5, 2026 for shareholders to participate.

WSE.title: Bragar Eagel & Squire, P.C. Urges Wise Group plc (WSE) Investors to Contact the Firm Before the September 29th Lead Plaintiff Deadline
WSE.summary: A class action lawsuit has been filed against Wise Group plc for allegedly making false and misleading statements about its regulatory risks, specifically regarding deficient anti-money laundering efforts and insufficient terrorism financing prevention measures ahead of its NASDAQ debut. Investors who purchased Wise securities between May 11, 2026 and July 23, 2026 have until September 29, 2026 to apply as lead plaintiff.

WSE.title: INVESTOR ALERT: Pomerantz Law Firm Reminds Investors with Losses on their Investment in Wise Group plc of Class Action Lawsuit and Upcoming Deadlines – WSE
WSE.summary: A class action lawsuit has been filed against Wise Group plc following investigations by Brussels prosecutors into over €500 million in suspicious transactions involving potential money laundering, and U.S. regulators' denial of the company's national trust bank license application due to deficiencies in anti-money laundering programs. The stock declined significantly following these disclosures in June and July 2026.

WSE.title: WSE Investors Have Opportunity to Lead Wise Group plc Securities Fraud Lawsuit with SBS Law
WSE.summary: A class action lawsuit has been filed against Wise Group plc (NASDAQ: WSE) for alleged violations of securities laws. The complaint alleges that Wise made false and misleading statements regarding its anti-money laundering procedures and understated regulatory risks. The class period runs from May 11, 2026 to July 23, 2026, with a deadline of September 28, 2026 for shareholders to participate.

CRWV.title: Why the Summer Slump is Setting Up Wall Street's Next Rally
CRWV.summary: Technical analysis shows QQQ is positioned for a rally, with historical data indicating positive returns following eight consecutive down closes. Bearish sentiment has reached extreme levels for six consecutive weeks, a contrarian indicator that preceded a multi-week rally in April. NVIDIA exceeded Wall Street expectations with $96.2B in revenue and announced significant capacity expansion plans for Neocloud partners, signaling strength in the AI sector.

CSCO.title: HPE vs. CSCO: Which Stock Has an Edge in the Networking Space?
CSCO.summary: HPE and Cisco are competing for enterprise and data center networking spending driven by AI demand. HPE strengthened its position through the Juniper acquisition with 148% networking revenue growth, while Cisco benefits from $9.3 billion in hyperscaler AI orders and strong data center momentum. Despite HPE's superior year-to-date performance (130% vs. 45.9%), Cisco is rated as the more compelling investment due to its stronger competitive position, diversified portfolio, and operating leverage, though both carry a Zacks Rank #2 (Buy).

BE.title: Kaplan Fox Encourages Capricor Therapeutics, Inc. (NASDAQ: CAPR) Investors to Contact the Firm Before the Deadline on September 28, 2026 for a Leadership Role
BE.summary: Kaplan Fox & Kilsheimer LLP has filed class action lawsuits against Capricor Therapeutics, Pentair plc, and Bloom Energy Corporation on behalf of investors who suffered losses. The primary case involves Capricor, where the FDA released briefing documents revealing that the company made undisclosed changes to its statistical analysis plan for a drug application, resulting in a 64% stock price drop on July 27, 2026.

XTIA.title: Securities Fraud Investigation Into XTI Aerospace, Inc. (XTIA) Announced – Shareholders Who Lost Money Urged To Contact The Law Offices of Frank R. Cruz
XTIA.summary: XTI Aerospace announced on August 17, 2026, that it could not timely file its Form 10-Q due to an internal review of its former CEO who resigned, along with other corporate governance matters. The stock fell 15.9% to $1.32 on August 18, 2026. A securities fraud investigation has been initiated on behalf of investors who lost money.

XTIA.title: INVESTOR ALERT: Pomerantz Law Firm Investigates Claims On Behalf of Investors of Papa John’s International, Inc. - PZZA
XTIA.summary: Pomerantz LLP announced investigations into securities fraud claims on behalf of investors in Papa John's International, XTI Aerospace, and Calumet. Papa John's stock fell 17.18% following disappointing full-year 2026 guidance despite beating Q2 expectations. The law firm is seeking investors to join class action lawsuits against these companies.

SYK.title: Stryker to participate in the 2026 Wells Fargo Healthcare Conference
SYK.summary: Stryker announced its participation in the 2026 Wells Fargo Healthcare Conference on September 8, 2026, with CFO Preston Wells and VP of Investor Relations Nick Mead participating in a fireside chat. The company also declared a quarterly dividend of $0.88 per share and reported second quarter 2026 operating results with net sales increasing 9.4% to $6.6 billion.

SYK.title: Intravascular Lithotripsy Market Size to Reach USD 4.19 Billion by 2035 as Coronary and Peripheral IVL Adoption Accelerates – SNS Insider
SYK.summary: The global Intravascular Lithotripsy (IVL) market is projected to grow from USD 1.01 billion in 2025 to USD 4.19 billion by 2035, expanding at a 15.3% CAGR. Growth is driven by increasing prevalence of calcified coronary and peripheral artery disease, adoption of minimally invasive procedures, and expanding peripheral IVL applications. North America leads with 58% market share, while Asia-Pacific is the fastest-growing region.

PCG.title: One of California's Largest Community Microgrids to be built in Rural Pescadero, California
PCG.summary: WestLight Energy announced completion of funding for a community microgrid project in Pescadero, California, designed to provide electricity resilience to an entire rural town of 700 residents. The project combines $3.5 million from PG&E's Microgrid Incentive Program, up to $4 million from PG&E for grid upgrades, $10 million from WestLight Energy, and $3 million from San Mateo County. Construction is expected to begin in mid-2029 with service starting in mid-2031.

PCG.title: Camus Energy Selected for Google for Startups Accelerator Program Focused on AI Solutions for the Energy Industry
PCG.summary: Camus Energy, a Google and Amazon alumni-founded startup, has been selected for Google's 10-week accelerator program focused on AI energy solutions. The company will demonstrate its FlexConnect software to major utilities including Duke Energy, Edison International, and PG&E, enabling AI data centers to connect to the grid 3-5 years faster using flexible operating limits and existing infrastructure.

PCGpA.title: One of California's Largest Community Microgrids to be built in Rural Pescadero, California
PCGpA.summary: WestLight Energy announced completion of funding for a community microgrid project in Pescadero, California, designed to provide electricity resilience to an entire rural town of 700 residents. Growth was driven by premium pointing devices, gaming products, and video collaboration solutions, with gross margins expanding 770 basis points aided by $61M in tariff refunds. JBLU.title: JetBlue (JBLU) Down 12.8% Since Last Earnings Report: Can It Rebound?
JBLU.summary: JetBlue Airways reported a Q2 2026 loss of 66 cents per share, beating estimates despite widening losses year-over-year. While revenues grew 14.5% to $2.7 billion and RASM improved 10.9%, surging fuel costs (up 80.7%) drove operating expenses up 20.8%, resulting in a $141 million operating loss. The airline maintains its JetForward cost-reduction program on track and introduced a 2028 EPS target of at least $1, but shares have underperformed the S&P 500 by 12.8% since the earnings release.

ITRI.title: Why Is Itron (ITRI) Down 3.4% Since Last Earnings Report?
ITRI.summary: Itron reported Q2 2026 non-GAAP EPS of $1.59, beating estimates by 22.3%, and raised full-year 2026 earnings guidance to $6.3-$6.5 from $5.75-$6.25. Despite a 7% year-over-year revenue decline to $563 million due to project timing in the Networked Solutions segment, the company demonstrated strong operational improvements with gross margin expansion of 460 basis points. Management expects Q3 revenue of $590-$600 million and reaffirmed full-year revenue guidance of $2.37-$2.41 billion with back-end loaded growth. Zacks assigned the stock a Rank #2 (Buy) rating.

ITRI.title: Smart Electricity Meters Global Market Outlook 2026-2031: Growth Driven by Smart Grid Modernization
ITRI.summary: The global smart electricity meter market is projected to grow from USD 13.74 billion in 2025 to USD 23.46 billion by 2031, driven by EU regulatory mandates for three-phase meter replacements, Asian AMI rollouts, and cellular connectivity adoption. However, chip shortages continue to inflate manufacturing costs by 15-25%. VSH.title: Vishay Intertechnology Expands Power Transformer Portfolio With New IFBT Series for Flyback Converter Topologies
VSH.summary: Vishay Intertechnology announced the expansion of its power transformer line with a new IFBT series of 17 customizable, surface-mount flyback transformers designed for flyback converter topologies. The devices support a wide 26V to 72V input range, operate at 250 kHz, and provide 1500 VRMS isolation. They enable output voltages from 1.8V to 24V and currents from 0.5A to 9.0A, serving applications in automotive lighting, industrial drives, telecom, and medical instrumentation. Samples and production quantities are available now with 10-12 week lead times.

VSH.title: Vishay Intertechnology to Showcase Solutions for AI Infrastructure and Physical AI at PCIM Asia 2026
VSH.summary: Vishay Intertechnology announced it will showcase its semiconductor and passive technology portfolio at PCIM Asia 2026, featuring reference designs and products for AI infrastructure, software-defined vehicles, and humanoid robotics. The company will display solutions spanning grid-level to board-level power delivery, including solid-state transformers, power conversion modules, and automotive power modules for next-generation vehicle platforms.

VSH.title: Vishay Intertechnology Automotive Grade Ferrite Common Mode Chokes Save Board Space While Increasing Efficiency
VSH.summary: Vishay Intertechnology announced four new AEC-Q200 qualified automotive-grade common mode chokes (ICM5050-A, ICM6050-A, IFLN-1210BE-A, IFLN-1812CZ-A) that offer low DCR (0.4-12 mΩ), high current capability up to 14 A, and impedance up to 11 kΩ at 100 MHz. These compact surface-mount devices are designed for DC/DC power supplies, LCD displays, and in-vehicle networks, with samples and production quantities available now.

FTK.title: Lowey Dannenberg, P.C. is Investigating Flotek Industries, Inc. (NYSE: FTK) for Potential Violations of the Federal Securities Laws
FTK.summary: Law firm Lowey Dannenberg is investigating Flotek Industries (NYSE: FTK) for potential federal securities violations following the cancellation of a major $400 million PREPA power generation agreement. The contract represented 57% of Flotek's revenue backlog. After Wolfpack Research published a critical report on August 17, 2026, PREPA terminated the agreement, causing Flotek's stock to plunge $7.17 per share (20%) to $28.66. The investigation focuses on whether Flotek concealed risks and provided accurate information to investors.

FTK.title: Important Notice to Long-Term Shareholders Aardvark Therapeutics, Inc. (NASDAQ: AARD); Flotek Industries, Inc. (NYSE: FTK); GoDaddy Inc. (NYSE: GDDY); and Hub Group, Inc. (NASDAQ: HUBG); Grabar Law Office is Investigating Claims on Your Behalf
FTK.summary: Grabar Law Office announced investigations into shareholder claims against four companies: Aardvark Therapeutics for allegedly misleading statements about drug safety leading to 56% stock decline; Flotek Industries for misrepresentations regarding a terminated Puerto Rico power project; GoDaddy for failing to disclose impact of promotional pricing on bookings; and Hub Group for material financial statement misstatements. Long-term shareholders may pursue corporate reforms and compensation.

ICCC.summary: ImmuCell Corporation (ICCC) reported Q2 2026 product sales of $7.19 million, up 11.5% year-over-year, with earnings of 20 cents per share versus 6 cents prior year. However, gross margins contracted significantly to 33.9% from 43.7% due to lower production volumes, material quality issues, and cost reclassifications. The stock declined 8.8% post-earnings. Management highlighted strong domestic sales growth of 27.7% and increased market share for First Defense, but noted international headwinds and manufacturing challenges. The company is investing $8 million in facility expansion expected to triple capacity by end of 2027.

The investigation was triggered by a 16% stock drop following a short-seller report questioning the legitimacy of a major customer agreement with VFG Holdings worth $133 million. The report alleged VFG was a newly incorporated shell company with minimal substance, while Hyliion generated only $8 million in cumulative revenue from 2021-2025 despite CEO compensation of $15.4 million.

FTFT.title: Future Fintech Group Announces Reverse Stock Split
FTFT.summary: Future FinTech Group Inc. (NASDAQ: FTFT) announced a 1-for-4 reverse stock split approved by its Board of Directors, effective August 28, 2026. The split will reduce outstanding shares from approximately 32.3 million to 8.1 million shares. Trading will resume on a split-adjusted basis on August 31, 2026 under the same ticker symbol with a new CUSIP number. Shareholder ownership percentages will remain unchanged.

MERC.title: Mercer International Inc. Announces C$20 Million (Approximately US$14 Million) in Government of Canada Support for its Peace River Mill
MERC.summary: Mercer International announced that the Government of Canada has committed C$20 million (approximately US$14 million) in financial support to its Peace River Pulp subsidiary through the Regional Tariff Response Initiative. The funding consists of a C$1 million non-repayable contribution and a C$19 million repayable contribution (repayment starting in 2031) to support the mill's modernization, productivity improvements, and expansion of bio-energy production and carbon capture capabilities.

AAME.summary: Atlantic American Corporation received a Nasdaq notice on August 20, 2026, for non-compliance with filing requirements due to delayed submission of its Form 10-Q for Q2 2026, as well as outstanding filings for the 2025 annual report and Q1 2026 quarterly report. RVSB.title: Riverview Bancorp, Inc. Announces $4.0 Million Stock Repurchase Program
RVSB.summary: Riverview Bancorp's Board of Directors adopted a stock repurchase program authorizing up to $4.0 million in common stock buybacks. The program will remain in effect for 12 months or until completion, with the company entering into a Rule 10b5-1 trading plan with Raymond James & Associates to facilitate repurchases. CEO Nicole Sherman stated the authorization reflects confidence in the company's financial strength and capital management.

SION.title: Securities Fraud Investigation Into Sionna Therapeutics, Inc. (SION) Continues – Shareholders Who Lost Money Urged To Contact Glancy Prongay Wolke & Rotter LLP, a Leading Securities Fraud Law Firm

SION.title: Sionna Therapeutics, Inc. (SION) Shareholders Who Lost Money – Contact Law Offices of Howard G. Smith About Securities Fraud Investigation

SION.title: Lincoln Educational Services Corp. (LINC) Shareholders Who Lost Money – Contact Law Offices of Howard G. Smith About Securities Fraud Investigation
SION.summary: Law Offices of Howard G. Smith is investigating potential federal securities law violations at Lincoln Educational Services Corp., Sionna Therapeutics, Inc., and Flotek Industries, Inc. on behalf of shareholders who suffered losses. FRPT.title: Pet Treats Market to Grow from USD 38.40 Billion in 2026 to USD 58.71 Billion by 2031, at a CAGR of 8.9% — MarketsandMarkets™
FRPT.summary: The global pet treats market is projected to grow at a CAGR of 8.9% from USD 38.40 billion in 2026 to USD 58.71 billion by 2031, driven by increasing pet ownership, pet humanization, and rising demand for premium, functional treats with natural ingredients. Jerky and meat-based treats dominate the market, while freeze-dried products and e-commerce channels show the fastest growth. Asia Pacific is expected to be the fastest-growing region.

CAPR.title: Bragar Eagel & Squire, P.C. Reminds Investors that a Class Action Lawsuit Has Been Filed Against Capricor Therapeutics, Inc. and Encourages Investors to Contact the Firm
CAPR.summary: A class action lawsuit has been filed against Capricor Therapeutics in the U.S. District Court for the Southern District of California. The complaint alleges that the company made materially false and misleading statements regarding changes to its statistical analysis plan for Deramiocel without FDA agreement, creating significant regulatory approval risks. Investors who purchased Capricor securities between December 17, 2025 and July 26, 2026 can join the lawsuit, with a lead plaintiff deadline of September 28, 2026.

CAPR.title: Bronstein, Gewirtz & Grossman LLC Urges Capricor Therapeutics, Inc. Investors to Act: Class Action Filed Alleging Investor Harm
CAPR.summary: A class action lawsuit has been filed against Capricor Therapeutics alleging that the company made materially false and misleading statements regarding its Deramiocel drug candidate. The complaint claims Capricor changed its statistical analysis plan without FDA agreement and failed to disclose the significant risk that the FDA would reject the Biologics License Application, putting regulatory approval for treating Duchenne muscular dystrophy in jeopardy.

CAPR.title: Kaplan Fox Encourages Capricor Therapeutics, Inc. (NASDAQ: CAPR) Investors to Contact the Firm Before the Deadline on September 28, 2026 for a Leadership Role
CAPR.summary: Kaplan Fox & Kilsheimer LLP has filed class action lawsuits against Capricor Therapeutics, Pentair plc, and Bloom Energy Corporation on behalf of investors who suffered losses. The primary case involves Capricor, where the FDA released briefing documents revealing that the company made undisclosed changes to its statistical analysis plan for a drug application, resulting in a 64% stock price drop on July 27, 2026.

CAPR.title: Capricor Therapeutics, Inc. Notice of September 28, 2026 Application Deadline for Class Action Lawsuit - Contact Lewis Kahn, Esq. at Kahn Swick & Foti, LLC, Before Application Deadline
CAPR.summary: A class action lawsuit has been filed against Capricor Therapeutics for allegedly failing to disclose material information regarding changes to its statistical analysis plan for its lead drug candidate Deramiocel. The FDA found the company made undisclosed modifications to the analysis plan just before data unblinding, which the agency deemed post-hoc and exploratory. Following FDA briefing documents on July 27, 2026, Capricor's stock plummeted 64% to $7.00 per share. Investors who purchased securities between December 17, 2025 and July 26, 2026 can apply to join the lawsuit by September 28, 2026.

CAPR.title: Deadline Alert: Capricor Therapeutics, Inc. (CAPR) Shareholders Who Lost Money Urged To Contact Glancy Prongay Wolke & Rotter LLP About Securities Fraud Lawsuit
CAPR.summary: Capricor Therapeutics faces a class action securities fraud lawsuit after the FDA criticized the company's statistical analysis methods for its Deramiocel cell therapy trial. The FDA's briefing documents questioned the scientific justification for data conversion methods and concluded the benefit-risk assessment was unfavorable. Following the FDA's concerns and an advisory committee's 9-3 vote against efficacy, Capricor's stock plummeted 62% on July 27, 2026. Investors who purchased shares between December 17, 2025 and July 26, 2026 can file lead plaintiff motions by September 28, 2026.

TOL.title: Toll Brothers Announces New Luxury Home Community Coming Soon to Las Vegas, Nevada
TOL.summary: Toll Brothers announced the opening and upcoming launches of three new luxury residential communities: Reflection Ridge in Las Vegas (opening September 2026 with homes starting at $1.2M), Crestmoor Estates in San Bruno, California (now open), and 2700 Westchester in Harrison, New York (opening fall 2026). The communities feature mid-century modern architecture, spacious layouts, and access to premium amenities.

TOL.title: Toll Brothers Announces New Luxury Townhome Community Coming this Fall to Harrison, New York
TOL.summary: Toll Brothers announces the opening of 2700 Westchester, a new luxury townhome community in Harrison, New York, featuring five floor plans with over 2,900 square feet of living space, starting at approximately $1.6 million. The community will offer premier amenities including an outdoor heated pool, outdoor kitchen, and putting green, with convenient access to Metro-North Station and Manhattan.

WRIV.title: White River Bancshares Co. Appoints Kevin Kooman to its Board of Directors
WRIV.summary: White River Bancshares Company announced the appointment of Kevin Kooman as an independent director to its Board of Directors. IPSAY.title: Ipsos: Monthly declaration of shares and voting rights - July 2026

IPSAY.title: Ipsos : Déclaration mensuelle d'actions et de droits de vote - Juillet 2026
IPSAY.summary: Ipsos published its monthly disclosure of share capital composition and voting rights as of July 31, 2026, reporting 43,203,225 shares and 49,670,029 theoretical voting rights. EQPT.title: Lowey Dannenberg, P.C. is Investigating EquipmentShare.com Inc. (NASDAQ: EQPT) for Potential Violations of the Federal Securities Laws
EQPT.summary: Law firm Lowey Dannenberg is investigating EquipmentShare.com Inc. for potential federal securities law violations following a short report by Umibōzu Research alleging undisclosed related-party transactions worth at least $77 million involving company founders. The stock price fell from $24.50 at IPO in January 2026 to $19.69 following the report's publication in June 2026.

EQPT.title: Kaplan Fox Notifies Investors of Cogent Communications Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: CCOI) of the Lead Plaintiff Deadline on September 21, 2026
EQPT.summary: Kaplan Fox has filed class action lawsuits against Cogent Communications Holdings, PROCEPT BioRobotics, and EquipmentShare.Com Inc. The primary case involves Cogent, where investors claim the company misrepresented demand for optical wavelengths and inflated order backlogs that never materialized into paying customers. Following CEO David Schaeffer's admission of customer delays in wavelength installations on May 4, 2026, Cogent's stock fell 29% to $16.37 per share. Lead plaintiff deadlines range from September 21-22, 2026.

EQPT.title: EquipmentShare.com Inc. Notice of September 21, 2026 Application Deadline for Class Action Lawsuit - Contact Lewis Kahn, Esq. at Kahn Swick & Foti, LLC, Before Application Deadline
EQPT.summary: A class action securities lawsuit has been filed against EquipmentShare.com Inc. (EQPT) for allegedly failing to disclose material information in its January 2026 IPO registration statement and during the subsequent class period. The company and its executives are accused of concealing undisclosed related party transactions with co-founder-controlled entities and providing materially misleading financial statements. Investors who purchased shares between January 23, 2026 and June 23, 2026 may be eligible to participate, with a September 21, 2026 deadline to request lead plaintiff status.

EQPT.title: Wix.com Ltd. Notice of September 22, 2026 Application Deadline for Class Action Lawsuit - Contact Lewis Kahn, Esq. at Kahn Swick & Foti, LLC, Before Application Deadline
EQPT.summary: Law firm Kahn Swick & Foti has filed class action securities lawsuits against Wix.com Ltd. and EquipmentShare.com Inc. for alleged securities fraud. Wix is accused of overstating AI product competitiveness and understating development costs during the February 2025 to May 2026 period. Investors who purchased securities during the class periods have until September 22-21, 2026 to apply as lead plaintiffs.

EQPT.title: EQPT DEADLINE NOTICE: ROSEN, A HIGHLY RECOGNIZED LAW FIRM, Encourages EquipmentShare.com Inc Investors with Losses in Excess of $100K to Secure Counsel Before Important Deadline in Securities Class Action - EQPT
EQPT.summary: Rosen Law Firm is notifying investors in EquipmentShare.com Inc, ARS Pharmaceuticals Inc, and Barclays PLC of ongoing securities class action lawsuits. EquipmentShare investors who purchased shares during the IPO or within the Class Period are encouraged to join the lawsuit, with a lead plaintiff deadline of September 21, 2026. The lawsuits allege material misstatements and omissions regarding business operations and financial disclosures.

LOCO.title: El Pollo Loco® Declares September 9 National Grilled Chicken Day
LOCO.summary: El Pollo Loco announced that National Day Calendar has officially recognized September 9 as National Grilled Chicken Day following a year-long campaign. The chain is celebrating with free chicken promotions for Loco Rewards members on September 9 and launching the Loco Hall of Flame Music Challenge (September 10-23) offering free chicken for life as the grand prize. The brand will also feature iconic menu items and deals throughout September.

SHLS.title: Shoals Technologies Group Prevails in Patent Infringement Case Against Voltage in North Carolina
SHLS.summary: Shoals Technologies Group won a patent infringement lawsuit against Voltage LLC and Ningbo Voltage Smart Production Co., with a jury awarding over $96 million in damages and finding willful infringement of Shoals' patents. The court also granted a preliminary injunction preventing Voltage's LYNX product from being manufactured, distributed, or sold in the United States. This victory follows a June ruling by the International Trade Commission that barred importation of Voltage's infringing products.

CYCU.title: Cycurion: 1-for-8 Reverse Split Backed by Stronger Fundamentals
CYCU.summary: Cycurion announced a 1-for-8 reverse stock split effective August 28, 2026, to meet listing requirements. The company reported significant operational improvements including gross margin expansion from 6.1% to 29.1% year-over-year, net debt reduction of over 50%, two strategic acquisitions, a $54.6 million HHS contract, and $15-17 million in firmly committed annual recurring revenue through 2028. CEO Kelly addressed a stock manipulation campaign and reaffirmed the company's target to achieve break-even profitability by Q2 2027.

ATHE.title: Multiple System Atrophy Clinical Trial Pipeline Gains Momentum: 22+ Companies Lead the Charge in Pioneering New Treatments | DelveInsight
ATHE.summary: The multiple system atrophy (MSA) clinical trial pipeline is experiencing significant momentum with 22+ companies developing 24+ pipeline drugs. The pipeline is diversifying beyond traditional approaches to include oral small molecules, cell replacement therapies, gene therapies, and next-generation alpha-synuclein inhibitors. Recent developments include Alterity Therapeutics achieving FDA alignment on Phase III for ATH434, Teva receiving Fast Track designation for TEV-56286, and iRegene Therapeutics enrolling the first patient in a randomized controlled trial for NouvNeu004 in China.

PRIM.title: Primoris Services Corporation Notice of September 21, 2026 Application Deadline for Class Action Lawsuit - Contact Lewis Kahn, Esq. at Kahn Swick & Foti, LLC, Before Application Deadline

SDXAY.summary: Sodexo has successfully issued a €1.1 billion euro-denominated bond in two tranches: €600 million maturing in 2032 at 4.00% and €500 million maturing in 2036 at 4.50%. The proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes and to refinance an existing €800 million bond maturing in April 2027. The new bonds are rated BBB by S&P and Baa1 by Moody's, and will be listed on Euronext Paris.

SDXAY.title: Sodexo completes a euro-denominated bond issuance of EUR 1,100,000,000
SDXAY.summary: Sodexo successfully issued EUR 1.1 billion in euro-denominated bonds across two tranches maturing in 2032 and 2036 with coupons of 4.00% and 4.50% respectively. DNOW.title: Bronstein, Gewirtz & Grossman LLC Urges DNOW Inc. Investors to Act: Class Action Filed Alleging Investor Harm
DNOW.summary: A class action lawsuit has been filed against DNOW Inc. and certain officers, alleging violations of federal securities laws. The complaint claims defendants made materially false statements regarding challenges in DNOW's merger with MRC Global Inc., specifically related to issues with MRC Global's enterprise resource planning system that were not properly disclosed to investors.

DNOW.title: DNOW Investors Have Opportunity to Lead DNOW Inc. Securities Fraud Lawsuit with SBS Law
DNOW.summary: Schall, Brown & Schwartz LLP announced a class action lawsuit against DNOW Inc. for alleged violations of securities laws. The firm claims DNOW made false and misleading statements regarding challenges in its merger with MRC Global Inc., specifically problems implementing a new enterprise resources planning system. Shareholders who purchased shares during the class period are encouraged to participate, with an October 2, 2026 deadline.

HDB.title: Bronstein, Gewirtz & Grossman LLC Urges HDFC Bank Limited Investors to Act: Class Action Filed Alleging Investor Harm
HDB.summary: A class action lawsuit has been filed against HDFC Bank Limited alleging that the bank made materially false and misleading statements regarding its financial performance. The complaint claims HDFC Bank camouflaged payments as marketing spend to pay higher interest to a state firm to induce deposits, activities allegedly approved by senior management that likely violated regulations. The class period covers purchases between July 17, 2023 and May 26, 2026, with a lead plaintiff deadline of October 13, 2026.

HDB.title: HDFC Bank Limited Securities Fraud Class Action Result of Deceptive Interest Payments and Approximately 4% Stock Decline - Investors may Contact Lewis Kahn, Esq, at Kahn Swick & Foti, LLC
HDB.summary: HDFC Bank Limited faces a securities class action lawsuit for failing to disclose that it disguised approximately Rs 45 crore ($4.7 million) as marketing expenditures to pay above-market interest rates to Maharashtra State Road Development Corporation. An internal investigation identified over ten senior officials responsible, including CEO Sashidhar Jagdishan. The stock declined 4.1% on the news. Investors have until October 13, 2026 to file lead plaintiff applications.

HDB.title: HDFC Bank Limited (HDB) Investors: Securities Fraud Class Action Filed, Contact Hagens Berman Before October 13, 2026 Lead Plaintiff Deadline
HDB.summary: A securities fraud class action has been filed against HDFC Bank Limited for allegedly concealing a covert scheme involving Rs 45 crore in disguised payments to induce state deposits while misrepresenting governance and compliance. The fraud involved routing above-market interest rate payments through the marketing department as sponsorship contributions, violating RBI regulations. The scheme surfaced in March 2026 with the resignation of the Chairman citing ethical concerns, followed by a May 2026 investigative report exposing the camouflaged payments. Investors who purchased HDFC securities between July 17, 2023, and May 26, 2026, can file claims by October 13, 2026.

BYAH.title: Bronstein, Gewirtz & Grossman LLC Urges Park Ha Biological Technology Co., Ltd. Investors to Act: Class Action Filed Alleging Investor Harm

The complaint claims the company made false and misleading statements, failed to disclose a fraudulent stock promotion and market manipulation scheme involving social media misinformation, and intentionally structured its IPO with an extremely low public float to facilitate manipulation. Investors who purchased Park Ha securities between December 27, 2024 and July 8, 2025 are eligible to join the case, with a lead plaintiff deadline of September 21, 2026.

APPF.title: PURE HomeRiver Deepens Its Commitment to AppFolio to Power the Next Phase of Its Growth

The company, which manages 40,000+ properties and plans to scale to 60,000, upgraded to AppFolio Plus in 2022 and will consolidate all operations onto the unified platform to standardize processes and support future growth.

REGN.title: Bronstein, Gewirtz & Grossman LLC Urges Regeneron Pharmaceuticals, Inc. Investors to Act: Class Action Filed Alleging Investor Harm

The complaint claims the study's preliminary statistical assumptions were flawed, the treatment arm lacked meaningful clinical differentiation, and the study was unlikely to achieve statistical significance. Investors who purchased Regeneron securities between August 1, 2025 and May 15, 2026 are eligible to join the case.

RELX.title: Scene Health Appoints Lisa Ritsky-Lamb as Chief Financial Officer to Accelerate Next Phase of Growth

NVA.title: First Three Holes of a 20,000-Meter Program Just Pushed a U.S. Antimony-Gold Resource Beyond Its Own Boundaries

The primary case involves Cogent, where investors claim the company misrepresented demand for optical wavelengths and inflated order backlogs that never materialized into paying customers. Following CEO David Schaeffer's admission of customer delays in wavelength installations on May 4, 2026, Cogent's stock fell 29% to $16.37 per share. PRCT.title: PROCEPT BioRobotics Corporation Securities Fraud Class Action Result of Undisclosed Inventory Issues and approximately 18% Stock Decline - Investors may Contact Lewis Kahn, Esq, at Kahn Swick & Foti, LLC
PRCT.summary: PROCEPT BioRobotics faces a securities class action lawsuit for failing to disclose material inventory issues. The company revealed on February 25, 2026 that handpiece sales had materially exceeded procedures since Q1 2023, resulting in over 10,000 units of excess field inventory. This disclosure caused the stock to plummet approximately 18% in two days, from $27.84 to $22.69 per share, as quarterly handpiece sales declined nearly 30% and the company missed annual revenue guidance by tens of millions of dollars. Investors who purchased shares between February 28, 2024 and February 25, 2026 have until September 22, 2026 to file lead plaintiff applications.

PRCT.title: INVESTOR ALERT: Pomerantz Law Firm Reminds Investors with Losses on their Investment in PROCEPT BioRobotics Corporation of Class Action Lawsuit and Upcoming Deadlines – PRCT
PRCT.summary: Pomerantz Law Firm has filed class action lawsuits against PROCEPT BioRobotics Corporation for alleged securities fraud. The lawsuit stems from PROCEPT's repeated missed sales guidance, accumulation of excess field inventory exceeding 10,000 units, and significant stock price declines following earnings announcements in August 2025, November 2025, and February 2026. Investors have until September 22, 2026, to join the class action.

NBIX.summary: Neurocrine Biosciences has received FDA IND acceptance for a Phase 2 study of NBI-1117567, an oral muscarinic M1/M4 selective agonist for Alzheimer's cognition. Nxera Pharma will receive a $10 million milestone payment. This marks the third compound in Nxera's muscarinic agonist portfolio to advance to Phase 2, following direclidine in Phase 3 and NBI-1117570 in Phase 2.

SYANY.title: AL Sydbank maintains momentum in Q2
SYANY.summary: AL Sydbank reported strong H1 2026 results with profit after tax of DKK 1.8bn and a return on tangible equity of 13.3%. The bank achieved DKK 175m in cost synergies from the merger integration, increased lending by DKK 3.4bn, and grew deposits by DKK 10.1bn. The bank consolidated 52 branches and maintains a robust CET1 ratio of 16.0%. Full-year 2026 profit is now expected at the top half of the DKK 3,500-4,000m range.

SYANY.title: AL Sydbank fastholder momentum i andet kvartal
SYANY.summary: AL Sydbank reports strong H1 2026 results with after-tax profit of 1.8 billion DKK and 13.3% return on tangible equity. Bank loans grew 3.4 billion DKK (2.4%), deposits increased 10.1 billion DKK, and cost synergies of 175 million DKK were realized. The bank continues integration of three merged entities with 52 branch consolidations completed. Full-year 2026 after-tax result expected in upper half of 3.5-4.0 billion DKK range.

SYANY.title: Finanskalender
SYANY.summary: AL Sydbank A/S has published its financial calendar for 2026-2027, announcing key reporting dates including quarterly reports, annual results, and the general meeting scheduled for March 18, 2027. The bank also confirmed dividend payout dates and submission deadlines for agenda items.

SYANY.title: Financial calendar
SYANY.summary: AL Sydbank A/S released its financial calendar for 2026-2027, announcing key dates for interim reports, annual financial statements, and the Annual General Meeting scheduled for 18 March 2027. The bank also announced ongoing share buyback programme transactions.

CAR.title: Avis Budget Group, Inc. Notice of September 29, 2026 Application Deadline for Class Action Lawsuit - Contact Lewis Kahn, Esq. at Kahn Swick & Foti, LLC, Before Application Deadline
CAR.summary: A class action securities lawsuit has been filed against Avis Budget Group and executives, alleging failure to disclose material information and market manipulation. Defendants Pentwater Capital Management and Halbower allegedly orchestrated a scheme involving aggressive stock purchases that triggered a short squeeze, causing Avis stock to surge 419% to $765.94 on April 21, 2026, before collapsing 74.51% by April 28. Investors who purchased Avis securities between February 20, 2025 and April 21, 2026 can apply to be lead plaintiff by September 29, 2026.

CAR.title: ROSEN, NATIONALLY REGARDED INVESTOR COUNSEL, Encourages Avis Budget Group, Inc. Investors to Secure Counsel Before Important Deadline in Securities Class Action Against Pentwater Capital Management LP - CAR
CAR.summary: A securities class action lawsuit has been filed against Pentwater Capital Management LP and its CEO Matthew Halbower, alleging they orchestrated a market manipulation scheme involving Avis Budget Group stock. The defendants, holding approximately 51% economic interest in Avis, allegedly engaged in aggressive stock purchases during February 2025 to April 2026 that triggered a short squeeze, artificially inflating the stock price and benefiting their holdings. Investors who purchased Avis securities during this period may be eligible for compensation, with a September 29, 2026 deadline to serve as lead plaintiff.

AVEX.title: AEVEX Corp. Notice of October 20, 2026 Application Deadline for Class Action Lawsuit - Contact Lewis Kahn, Esq. at Kahn Swick & Foti, LLC, Before Application Deadline
AVEX.summary: A class action securities lawsuit has been filed against AEVEX Corp. alleging that the company and its executives concealed a pre-arranged plan with Madison and underwriters to prematurely override a 180-day lock-up commitment following the April 2026 IPO. The alleged scheme enabled Madison to sell shares and reap over $200 million while underwriters earned additional fees. Investors who purchased AEVEX stock between April 17 and June 4, 2026 can apply to be lead plaintiff by October 20, 2026.

AVEX.title: Bragar Eagel & Squire, P.C. Announces that a Class Action Lawsuit Has Been Filed Against AEVEX Corp. and Encourages Investors to Contact the Firm
AVEX.summary: A class action lawsuit has been filed against AEVEX Corp. in the U.S. District Court for the Southern District of California, alleging that the company and its executives concealed a pre-arranged plan with Madison and underwriters to prematurely override a 180-day lock-up agreement following the company's April 17, 2026 IPO. The alleged scheme would have allowed Madison to raise over $200 million through a secondary public offering while underwriters earned additional fees. Investors who purchased shares during the IPO or between April 17-June 4, 2026 are eligible to join the lawsuit, with a deadline of October 20, 2026 to apply as lead plaintiff.

IRON.title: Disc Medicine Investor News: If You Have Suffered Losses in Disc Medicine, Inc. (NASDAQ: IRON), You Are Encouraged to Contact The Rosen Law Firm About Your Rights
IRON.summary: The Rosen Law Firm is investigating potential securities claims against Disc Medicine, Inc. (NASDAQ: IRON) following an FDA Complete Response Letter on February 13, 2026, regarding its bitopertin program. The FDA stated it could not approve the new drug application due to uncertainties requiring additional evidence. Disc Medicine's stock price fell 22% on the news. Investors who suffered losses are encouraged to join a prospective class action.

BETR.title: Better Founder Vishal Garg Files Court Response, Citing Board Contradictions and Shareholder Value Losses
BETR.summary: Vishal Garg, founder and former CEO of Better.com, filed a court opposition against the company's request for injunctive relief to halt his shareholder consent solicitation. Garg argues the Board's actions are contradictory, noting the company's own filings describe him as 'critical to operations' and shareholders re-elected him with 99.53% support in June, yet the Board terminated him in August and later offered him a $15M+ package. Better's stock fell 41.6% the day after his removal and declined nearly 60% by August 21. Garg is seeking to remove five Board members and return the company to profitability.

CELU.title: Celularity Provides Update Regarding Nasdaq Listing Compliance
CELU.summary: Celularity Inc. (Nasdaq: CELU) received a notification from Nasdaq on August 21, 2026, stating the company is not in compliance with listing rules due to failure to timely file its Quarterly Reports on Form 10-Q for periods ended June 30, 2026 and March 31, 2026. The company has until September 4, 2026 to submit a compliance plan, with a maximum 180-day grace period until November 16, 2026. Trading of the stock continues unaffected while the company works to complete and file the delayed reports.

BCS.title: EQPT DEADLINE NOTICE: ROSEN, A HIGHLY RECOGNIZED LAW FIRM, Encourages EquipmentShare.com Inc Investors with Losses in Excess of $100K to Secure Counsel Before Important Deadline in Securities Class Action - EQPT
BCS.summary: Rosen Law Firm is notifying investors in EquipmentShare.com Inc, ARS Pharmaceuticals Inc, and Barclays PLC of ongoing securities class action lawsuits. EquipmentShare investors who purchased shares during the IPO or within the Class Period are encouraged to join the lawsuit, with a lead plaintiff deadline of September 21, 2026. The lawsuits allege material misstatements and omissions regarding business operations and financial disclosures.

DLR.title: Digital Realty, 싱가포르에 50MW 규모 신규 데이터센터 개발 사업자로 선정
DLR.summary: Digital Realty has been selected as an operator under Singapore's second Data Center Call for Application (DC-CFA2) to develop a 50MW data center facility on Jurong Island. The new facility will support AI inference, high-performance computing, and enterprise workloads while meeting strict energy efficiency standards with over 50% of power sourced from renewable energy. This expansion strengthens Digital Realty's position in Asia-Pacific and builds on its existing operations in Singapore since 2010.

TWO.title: UWM Holdings Corporation (UWMC) Investors with $150K+ Losses Have Opportunity to Lead UWM Securities Fraud Class Action Lawsuit
TWO.summary: UWM Holdings Corporation faces a securities class action lawsuit after its stock plunged 34% on August 6, 2026, following disclosure of a $603 million hedging loss tied to its failed acquisition of Two Harbors Investment Corp. The company allegedly failed to disclose it was over-hedged on the transaction, and when the deal fell through in March 2026, the unwind resulted in massive losses and a 38% sequential equity decline. UWM announced a dilutive recapitalization plan to address the damage.

CLMT.title: INVESTOR ALERT: Pomerantz Law Firm Investigates Claims On Behalf of Investors of Calumet, Inc. - CLMT
CLMT.summary: Pomerantz LLP is investigating potential securities fraud claims against Calumet, Inc. following the company's August 7, 2026 earnings report. Calumet disclosed significant operational challenges including a $6.2 million EBITDA decline in its Performance Brands segment due to input cost spikes and timing issues, over $40 million in foregone margins at Montana Renewables from production downtime, and a strategic delay in SAF production ramp-up. The stock fell 5.73% to $39.48 per share on the news.

OLN.title: INVESTOR ALERT: Pomerantz Law Firm Investigates Claims On Behalf of Investors of Olin Corporation - OLN
OLN.summary: Pomerantz LLP is investigating potential securities fraud claims against Olin Corporation following the company's disclosure of an unplanned shutdown at its vinyl chloride monomer plant in Freeport, Texas. The disruption reduced Q2 2026 adjusted EBITDA by $40 million, with an additional $20 million impact expected in Q3. Following the announcement on July 31, 2026, Olin's stock price fell 16.51% to $18.51 per share.

TDOC.title: INVESTOR ALERT: Pomerantz Law Firm Investigates Claims On Behalf of Investors of Teladoc Health, Inc. - TDOC
TDOC.summary: Pomerantz LLP is investigating potential securities fraud claims against Teladoc Health following the company's significant revenue guidance downgrade on July 29, 2026. Teladoc reduced its full-year 2026 revenue guidance from $2.48-$2.58 billion to $2.36-$2.45 billion, citing uncertainties in cash pay and business model transition. The announcement triggered a 38.32% stock price decline, falling $2.60 per share to $6.58.

PZZA.title: INVESTOR ALERT: Pomerantz Law Firm Investigates Claims On Behalf of Investors of Papa John’s International, Inc. - PZZA
PZZA.summary: Pomerantz LLP announced investigations into securities fraud claims on behalf of investors in Papa John's International, XTI Aerospace, and Calumet. Papa John's stock fell 17.18% following disappointing full-year 2026 guidance despite beating Q2 expectations. The law firm is seeking investors to join class action lawsuits against these companies.

CCB.title: INVESTOR ALERT: Pomerantz Law Firm Investigates Claims on Behalf of Investors of Coastal Financial Corporation - CCB
CCB.summary: Pomerantz LLP is investigating potential securities fraud claims against Coastal Financial Corporation (CCB) following the company's report of a $42.1 million net loss in Q2 2026, driven by $68.8 million in accounting adjustments related to a portfolio company. The announcement triggered a 43.52% stock price decline on July 30, 2026.

GIL.title: Gildan Investor News: If You Have Suffered Losses in Gildan Activewear Inc. (NYSE: GIL), You Are Encouraged to Contact The Rosen Law Firm About Your Rights
GIL.summary: The Rosen Law Firm is investigating potential securities claims against Gildan Activewear Inc. following a short seller report by Jehoshaphat Research that alleged the company engaged in financial engineering to obscure negative organic growth. Gildan's stock fell 18.7% on June 16, 2026, after the report questioned the company's organic growth and sales practices. The firm is preparing a class action lawsuit to recover investor losses.

FMAO.title: F&M Bank Welcomes Gregory R. Allen to Board of Directors
FMAO.summary: F&M Bank, owned by Farmers & Merchants Bancorp, Inc., announced a planned Board transition on August 25, 2026. Andrew J. Briggs, who served seven years and was Chairman from 2024-2025, is retiring. Gregory R. Allen, with over four decades of banking and community development experience, has been elected to the Board, reflecting the bank's commitment to thoughtful succession planning and maintaining strong governance.

RNST.title: Renasant Announces Chief Financial Officer Transition
RNST.summary: Renasant Corporation announced that Catherine Mealor will join as Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer on October 5, 2026, assuming the CFO role on January 1, 2027. Incumbent CFO Jim Mabry will step down at year-end 2026 and transition to retirement in early 2027, with plans for Board nomination in 2027. Mealor brings over 20 years of financial services experience from KBW.

ELWT.title: Elauwit Investor News: If You Have Suffered Losses in Elauwit Connection, Inc. (NASDAQ: ELWT), You Are Encouraged to Contact The Rosen Law Firm About Your Rights
ELWT.summary: Elauwit Connection, Inc. (NASDAQ: ELWT) is facing a securities class action investigation after filing an 8-K on February 27, 2026, announcing non-reliance on previously issued interim financial statements due to errors in network construction project revenue recognition during the first nine months of 2025. The disclosure resulted in a 6.8% stock price decline. The Rosen Law Firm is preparing a class action lawsuit to recover investor losses.

SUJA.title: Robbins LLP Reminds Investors it is Investigating Suja Life, Inc. for Potential Securities Claims
SUJA.summary: Shareholder rights law firm Robbins LLP is investigating Suja Life, Inc. (NASDAQ: SUJA) for potential securities law violations and breach of fiduciary duties. The organic juice company's stock plummeted over 70% below its $21 IPO price after reporting a 21% sequential sales drop and slashed guidance in August 2026, citing weakness in the grocery channel.

WLTH.title: Robbins LLP Reminds Investors it is Investigating Wealthfront Corporation for Potential Securities Claims
WLTH.summary: Shareholder rights law firm Robbins LLP is investigating Wealthfront Corporation for potential securities violations and breach of fiduciary duties. The investigation follows significant stock price declines after disappointing financial disclosures in January 2026 (16.84% drop) and June 2026 (14.35% drop), with concerns about declining net deposits and profitability metrics.

PEN.title: Incuvate Files Patent Infringement Lawsuit Against Penumbra
PEN.summary: Incuvate has filed a patent-infringement lawsuit against Penumbra in U.S. District Court for the Northern District of California, alleging that Penumbra's THUNDERBOLT Neurovascular Thrombectomy System and related components infringe five Incuvate patents covering real-time aspiration monitoring technology. Incuvate is seeking damages, injunctive relief, and other remedies.

BVNRY.summary: Bavarian Nordic A/S reported insider transactions on August 24-25, 2026, with CEO Paul Chaplin selling 90,000 shares at DKK 212.42 and a related party Maria Tzataris selling 14,840 shares at DKK 207.91. The company announced strong first half 2026 results and plans a new share buy-back program of up to DKK 750 million.

BVNRY.summary: Bavarian Nordic A/S reports insider transactions where CEO Paul Chaplin sold 90,000 shares at DKK 212.42 per share (DKK 19.1 million) on August 24, 2026, and Maria Tzatzaris, closely associated with Chaplin, sold 14,840 shares at DKK 207.91 per share (DKK 3.1 million) on August 21, 2026, both on Nasdaq Copenhagen.

HIMS.summary: The Portnoy Law Firm has initiated an investigation into possible securities fraud against Hims & Hers Health, Inc., alleging the telehealth platform deceived consumers by charging them for unwanted prescription medication subscriptions without express informed consent. The company's advertising and intake forms allegedly misrepresented that consultations were free and created no purchase obligation. ALOY.title: Greenland Rare Earth Project Books Its First Indicated Resource
ALOY.summary: Greenland Mines Ltd. announced the first S-K 1300 technical report for its Sarfartoq neodymium-praseodymium rare earth project in Greenland, achieving a landmark classification of 6.9 million tonnes at Indicated resource status—the first in 15 years of project history. The report models combined open pit and underground mining scenarios (Hybrid case) and includes a strategic partnership with Neo Performance Materials, which gains offtake rights on up to 60% of future production. This regulatory milestone enables the project to support preliminary economic assessment studies, addressing a critical gap in Western rare earth feedstock development.
